invariants.rationale: The returned HoodieIndex instance is created via JavaHoodieIndexFactory.createIndex and should not be null according to typical factory behavior and HoodieIndex semantics.
The result must always be a HoodieIndex or its subtype, as required by the return type and factory method.
The method always returns the value produced by JavaHoodieIndexFactory.createIndex(config), so the result must equal this invocation.
